name: middleware-hasauthtoken-async-config-read
hook: middleware hasAuthToken must read cookiePrefix from config dynamically
body: The middleware hasAuthToken function claimed in comments to check both configured prefix and payload-token fallback, but the code only checked payload-token. Fixed by making hasAuthToken async so it can import @payload-config and read the actual cookiePrefix, then check both the configured cookie name and the fallback.
why: The loginAction and getMeUser read cookiePrefix from Payload config, but middleware hardcoded 'payload-token'. If cookiePrefix ever differs from 'payload', middleware would not recognize the auth cookie.

name: async-middleware-breaks-tests
hook: Making Next.js middleware async requires test files to await the call
body: When changing middleware functions to async, all test files that call middleware must now await the result. TypeScript will surface these as errors on the Promise<NextResponse> type.
why: TypeScript correctly identifies that async middleware returns Promise<NextResponse>, so accessing .status or .headers directly without await is a type error.
